_meta.billing: Photo identification and reports are independent purchases with separate authority and receipts. Charge identification only after a clear result; it never buys a report. Review the returned candidate and explicitly confirm its exact revision and quoted fee before report research starts; reusing an owned identification pays no second identification fee. Invalid or ambiguous inputs and insufficient processed SBZ incur no charge. Examples are explicitly selected and pinned. Exact retries never charge again.

operations.confirm: explicit approval of the exact identified candidate and quoted fee
operations.continue: explicitly renewed unpaid authority at current quoted price

description: Identify a card photo or commission a separate Card Story. Use research action=offer to read products and prices for free; use trade to find items for sale. Identification and reports are distinct purchases requiring explicit max_fee, and a report starts only after approval of the exact candidate and fee. Ambiguous identification is uncharged; private inputs never enter the public edition. Supply the selected product, owned input and stable request_id; retry identical instructions rather than purchasing delivery twice. It returns identification candidates, order progress or a completed report and billing.

action.description: Choose the operation; supply only its applicable fields. offer: read available research products and prices; request: request the selected research product; status: read current setup or delivery state; continue: complete only the named pending step; confirm: execute the exact approved prepared authority; download: retrieve an owned completed result; cancel: cancel an eligible pending operation.

candidate_id.description: Exact returned identification candidate to approve.

expected_revision.description: Exact revision last read; stale edits are refused.

identification_order_id.description: Owned completed identification UUID to reuse without a second identification fee. UUID.

input.description: Arguments for the selected operation; the server validates its exact required fields.

card_details.description: Known card identity supplied by the person; do not invent missing facts.

collector_number.description: Printed collector number, including the denominator if present.

country.description: ISO country code for the declared location or legal principal.

currency.description: Exact currency symbol/descriptor returned by the listing or offer; do not convert the native amount.

grades.description: Explicit grading companies and grades to research.

company.description: Grading company shown on the certification.

grade.description: Actual declared grade; never infer certification.

kind.description: Select the record, decision or variant described by this container. raw: ungraded card; graded: certified card with the declared company/grade.

image.description: One image for identification, within the published format and size bounds.

action.description: Choose the operation; supply only its applicable fields. upload: supply encoded image bytes; import: fetch the supplied source image URL.

data_base64.description: Canonical base64 JPEG, PNG or WebP, without a data URL prefix. Maximum 10 MB (10,000,000 bytes); the shorter image side must be at least 600 px. New inputs are oriented, stripped of metadata and optimized to WebP up to 2400 px on the long side and 1 MiB, retaining at least 600 px on the short side.

mime_type.description: Actual image MIME type. image/jpeg: JPEG image; image/png: PNG image; image/webp: WebP image.

url.description: Public HTTPS JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB (10,000,000 bytes), with a short side of at least 600 px. New inputs are oriented, stripped of metadata and optimized to WebP up to 2400 px on the long side and 1 MiB, retaining at least 600 px on the short side. No credentials, private networks or nonstandard ports.

text.description: Text supplied by the person for this request.

max_fee.description: Approved immediate service fee ceiling as a whole SBZ string; separate from the item price.

product.description: Choose identification or a separate Card Story product; one never silently purchases the other. report: send a private safety report; identification: identify the card without buying a report; example: explicitly chosen published sample report.

request_id.description: UUID for one logical request; reuse it with identical arguments after uncertainty. UUID.

name: research

billing.description: charged, assessed, balance and available_credits are whole SBZ strings or null; receipt_id identifies the saved fee. Replays never charge twice.

committed_stages.description: Stages already committed before a later refusal; retain their receipts.

data.description: Order UUID, candidates, quoted whole-SBZ fees, progress and owned download URL. IDs are exact returned identifiers (UUID where declared); prices retain amount/currency (123 USD); times use ISO 8601 UTC; cursors are opaque.

error.description: Optional business error: code, message, HTTP status, retryable and recovery details.

next.description: Exactly one required continuation: call, input, approval, choice, wait or done. It never grants new consent.

pagination.description: Optional next-page call; not required work or consent.

retry.description: Optional exact request_id and permitted recovery call.

state.description: Outcome: finished, still processing, needs approval/input, or refused.

summary.description: Plain-language result, including a business error.

title: Identify cards and request research
